title: 桌面整理：三次完整搬运＋键盘边缘接触推进
phases: Identify alarm clock/drawer support, figurine/stand, mouse/mouse pad, keyboard/frame.
Use complete local transfer to put alarm clock on drawer, figurine upright on stand, and mouse on pad. Choose current order preserving keyboard push corridor.
For keyboard push select current start at contact edge and end at frame alignment; local calibrated features define the trajectory, not a guessed directional nudge.
Inspect figurine tipping, actual keyboard displacement and all supports; recover only the unresolved object, then home. Do not invent a drawer-opening subtask.
failure_lesson: Figurines tipped after completed transfers, and completed pushes left keyboard misaligned. Repeated unavailable patch/stereo methods did not recover geometry.
reference_success_scope: External aggregate has limited native successes; the new full local operations need validation.
